
---
title: "Sleep Health Dashboard"
output: 
  flexdashboard::flex_dashboard:
    orientation: rows
    vertical_layout: fill
    theme: flatly
---

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# Load necessary libraries
library(flexdashboard)
library(tidyverse)
library(plotly)
library(DT)
library(corrplot)

# Load dataset
sleep_data <- read.csv("Sleep_health_and_lifestyle_dataset.csv", stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

# Clean column names
colnames(sleep_data) <- make.names(colnames(sleep_data))

# Convert appropriate columns to factors
sleep_data$Gender <- as.factor(sleep_data$Gender)
sleep_data$Occupation <- as.factor(sleep_data$Occupation)
sleep_data$BMI.Category <- as.factor(sleep_data$BMI.Category)
sleep_data$Sleep.Disorder <- as.factor(sleep_data$Sleep.Disorder)
```

### Key Metrics
```{r}
summary_data <- sleep_data %>%
  summarise(
    Avg_Sleep = round(mean(Sleep.Duration, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_Stress = round(mean(Stress.Level, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_HeartRate = round(mean(Heart.Rate, na.rm = TRUE), 1),
    Avg_Steps = round(mean(Daily.Steps, na.rm = TRUE), 0)
  )

summary_data %>% 
  pivot_longer(cols = everything(), names_to = "Metric", values_to = "Value") %>%
  ggplot(aes(x = Metric, y = Value, fill = Metric)) +
  geom_col() +
  theme_minimal() +
  labs(title = "Key Averages", x = NULL, y = NULL) +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

### Sleep by Age and Gender
```{r}
plot_ly(sleep_data, 
        x = ~Age, y = ~Sleep.Duration, color = ~Gender, 
        type = 'scatter', mode = 'markers',
        marker = list(size = 8, opacity = 0.6)) %>%
  layout(title = "Sleep Duration by Age and Gender",
         xaxis = list(title = "Age"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Sleep Duration (hrs)"))
```

### Activity vs Sleep (by Sleep Disorder)
```{r}
plot_ly(sleep_data, 
        x = ~Physical.Activity.Level, y = ~Sleep.Duration, 
        color = ~Sleep.Disorder,
        type = "scatter", mode = "markers",
        marker = list(opacity = 0.7)) %>%
  layout(title = "Physical Activity vs Sleep Duration by Sleep Disorder",
         xaxis = list(title = "Physical Activity Level"),
         yaxis = list(title = "Sleep Duration (hrs)"))
```

### Correlation Heatmap
```{r}
numeric_cols <- sleep_data %>% select_if(is.numeric)
numeric_data <- na.omit(numeric_cols)
cor_matrix <- cor(numeric_data)

corrplot(cor_matrix, method = "color", type = "lower", tl.cex = 0.8)
```

### Interactive Data Table
```{r}
datatable(sleep_data, options = list(pageLength = 10, scrollX = TRUE))
```
